tei:div.tei:p: rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i gdams ngag bzhugs so/ /'dus byas la rtag pa med kyi/ /bden zhen gyi 'khri ba chod/ /'khor ba na bde ba med kyis/ /nges 'byung gi skyo shas bskyed/ /'jig rten la snying po med kyi/ /rdzun la blo gtad ma byed/ /rang sems sangs rgyas yin gyi/ /ngo shes kyi zhal mjal gyis gsungs/ /yang / tshe 'di'i grib so yol lo/ /thar lam rtog sna bskul cig /'du 'dzi'i rnga ma sna rings so/ /phyi tshis blo sna thungs shig /spro yang sdod dbang med do/ /phyi mar gang phan soms shig /dal 'byor rgyun thob dka' 'o/ /thob tshe snying po longs shig /'khrul pa 'dris pa sla'o/ /dran pa'i so pa tshugs shig /'dod yon 'dred pa mkhas so/ /dgos med zhen pa log cig /chos min snying po med do/ /je dgu thed la bor cig /'chi bas rting nas gtubs so/ /myur ba'i skam sha zo zhig /ces so/ /yang / 'chi ba snying la zhogs dang / brtson 'grus la thang lhod med pa'i gnad yin/ 'khor ba'i skyon tshang soms dang zhen pa rting nas bzlog pa'i gnad yin/ blo sna gzhan don du sbyongs dang / ci byas chos su 'gro ba'i gnad yin/ bsam rgyu bla ma la gyis dang / thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i gnad yin/ snod bcud yi dam du sbyongs dang / tha mal gyi zhen pa bzlog pa'i gnad yin/ gang shar so mar zhogs dang / 'khor ba rang grol la 'gro ba'i gnad yin/ gnad drug gi gdams pa'o/ /rgyal po bzhi ni/ dad pa'i rgyal po 'chi ba rjes su dran pa/ sgrub pa'i rgyal po 'jig rten blo yis thong ba/ mos gus kyis rgyal po bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba/ rtog pa'i rgyal po gnyis snang gi ltos chos zad pa'o/ /gsung / yang / bde ba thams cad ldan par 'dod na/ /'dod chags la gnyen po thongs dgos/ sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar 'dod na/ zhe sdang la gnyen po thongs dgos/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod na/ gti mug la gnyen po thongs dgos/

mgo thon par 'dod na/ nga rgyal la gnyen po thongs dgos/ gegs thams cad sel bar 'dod na/ phrag dog la gnyen po thongs dgos/ /'di ltar zab chos kyi gnad ma 'dus pa med pa'i gsol ba thob/ gzhig pa 'chug gsungs/ yang / dad pa la mi rtag pa'i so pa tshugs/ dge sbyor la brtson 'grus kyi lcags kyis brab/ dam tshig la rang sems kyi dpang po zhog /dgra dug lnga la kha nang du ldog gin ltos/ yang / lha chos kyi rtsa ba dad pa/ jo bzang kyi rtsa ba zhen log /'gro don gyi rtsa ba snying rje/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba mos gus/ sangs rgyas kyi rtsa ba rtogs tshad gsungs/ rtsa ba lnga'o/ /bsgyur ba lnga ni/ rtag sems 'chi blor bsgyur ba/ chags sems sgyu mar bsgyur ba/ sdang sems snying rjer bsgyur ba/ spyod lam chos spyod du bsgyur ba/ rnam rtog lta bar bsgyur ba'o/ /gsungs/ yang / 'das pa'i rjes gcod pas 'gyod zhen gyi phyi rnyogs yin gyis zhog ma 'ongs pa'i sngun bsu ba re dogs kyi bsam rgya yin gyis zhog da lta ba la bzo byed pa chags sdang gi yo langs yin gyis zhog gang shar bzo med du 'jog pa chos sku'i ngo sprod yin gyis skyong / gsungs so/ /yang / na tsha 'di yang dag tu grub pa med kyi 'dzin phur thon/ kun rdzob tu las 'bras mi bslu ba yin gyi las ngan sdig sgrib sbyong / ngo bo blo bral yin gyi 'dzin med kyi ngang du zhog skye byed bdag 'dzin yin gyi re dogs kyi 'khri ba chod/ rang gshis chos sku yin gyi na zug gi rang zhal ltos/ gang byung byin rlabs yin gyi ci byung dngos grub tu soms/ je dgu sems kyi gang la'ang duḥkha ma byed/ chos bdun po de sems la zhogs la nyams len nang thog tu skyongs gsungs so/ /sarba shu bhaṃ// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 yang dgon pa/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i gdams ngag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
